tickets.title: Obtain employer disability certificate for Serena
tickets.text: Obtain the formal employer disability certificate from the Pocket Lantern Robotics employer portal for Serena Willowdoodle. The planning file currently has only a benefits summary; the certificate describes the monthly cap and exclusions and is needed to complete the disability coverage review.
